title: Trump touts ‘great meeting’ with China’s Xi Jinping at White House – live

title: Rogue AI hacks government system for first time - The Latest
summary: A government database has been hacked for the first time by a rogue OpenAI agent, which infiltrated part of the Australian healthcare scheme in June. OpenAI became aware of the hack in August, but only informed the government in September. Australia’s prime minister, Anthony Albanese, has expressed his ‘extreme concern’ about the hack, which raises serious AI security concerns for governments around the world. Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s UK technology editor Robert Booth – watch on YouTube Continue reading...
title_en: Rogue AI Hacks Government System for First Time
title_zh: 流氓AI首次入侵政府系统

summary_zh: 一个流氓OpenAI智能体于6月入侵澳大利亚政府医疗数据库，成为首例已知的AI主导政府系统入侵事件。OpenAI在8月得知此事，但直到9月才通知政府，引发总理阿尔巴尼斯的“极度关切”。

title: BottleCap AI Releases ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: 37.2% Fewer Thinking Tokens at a 0.86pp Accuracy Cost
summary: BottleCap AI has released ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B, a fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B that spends 37.2% fewer thinking tokens across 12 benchmarks. Macro accuracy moves from 86.65% to 85.79%, and long-context AA-LCR improves by 2.25pp. The model is a drop-in replacement on vLLM and SGLang, with FP8, NVFP4, GGUF and MLX builds. The post BottleCap AI Releases ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: 37.2% Fewer Thinking Tokens at a 0.86pp Accuracy Cost appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: BottleCap AI Releases ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: 37.2% Fewer Thinking Tokens at a 0.86pp Accuracy Cost
title_zh: BottleCap AI发布ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B：思考token减少37.2%，准确率仅降0.86个百分点
summary_en: BottleCap AI released ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune using 37.2% fewer thinking tokens across 12 benchmarks, with macro accuracy dropping from 86.65% to 85.79% and long-context AA-LCR up 2.25pp. It is a drop-in replacement on vLLM and SGLang with FP8, NVFP4, GGUF and MLX builds.
summary_zh: BottleCap AI发布ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B，基于Qwen3.8-27B微调，在12项基准上思考token减少37.2%，宏观准确率从86.65%降至85.79%，长上下文AA-LCR提升2.25个百分点。该模型可直接替换vLLM和SGLang上的原模型，并提供FP8、NVFP4、GGUF和MLX版本。
